title: Skin
subtitle: Skin 是多義詞。 它可以指人體／動物的皮膚、皮膚的特定解剖層、膚色與面部外觀、動物皮、蔬果外皮，甚至比喻性的材料表層。因此替換前必須先判斷是在說 whole skin, ski
description: Skin 是多義詞。 它可以指人體／動物的皮膚、皮膚的特定解剖層、膚色與面部外觀、動物皮、蔬果外皮，甚至比喻性的材料表層。因此替換前必須先判斷是在說 whole skin, skin appearance, epidermis/dermis, animal hide, fruit peel, 還是 surface layer。

options.explanation: Outer layer ✓ — means the outside layer covering a body, object, material or fruit. Here, the meaning is simply an outside covering rather than human skin. That specific anatomical, appearance, material, or covering meaning makes Outer layer the best replacement.

Surface layer — means the layer at the surface of a material, body part or object. This is a general layer term and is too broad when the sentence requires a specific anatomical, animal-skin or food term. The decisive clue is that the meaning is simply an outside covering rather than human skin.

Epidermis — means the outermost anatomical layer of the skin. This names only the skin's outermost anatomical layer, so it is too narrow for whole skin, complexion or non-human materials. The decisive clue is that the meaning is simply an outside covering rather than human skin.

Flesh — means soft tissue beneath the skin rather than the skin itself. This refers to soft tissue beneath the skin and therefore points to a different body structure. The decisive clue is that the meaning is simply an outside covering rather than human skin.

Shell — means a hard protective outer covering and is not a synonym for soft skin. This implies a hard outer covering rather than skin or a soft surface layer. The decisive clue is that the meaning is simply an outside covering rather than human skin.

Coating — means a layer applied to a surface rather than naturally occurring skin. A coating is applied or deposited on a surface; it does not usually mean natural skin. The decisive clue is that the meaning is simply an outside covering rather than human skin.
